brief: Reorders the items of a list: moves one item to another position, swaps two, reverses, rotates, shuffles, or brings an item to either end.
detail: It is the reordering helper of stzList, which builds one over itself for its Move, Swap, MoveToStart, MoveToEnd and SwapFirstAndLast methods; build one with new stzListMover when you only need to reorder. It works on its own copy, so a stzList passed in is never changed, and you read the result with Content. A verb (Move, Swap, Reverse, RotateLeft, Shuffle ...) reorders the held list in place and returns nothing, its Q form returning the mover for chaining; the past-tense forms (Reversed, RotatedLeft, RotatedRight, Shuffled) return a reordered copy and leave the mover alone. Positions count from 1, and a position outside the list moves nothing and says nothing. Move and Swap accept the pair forms [ :From, 2 ] and [ :To, 5 ], [ :Between, 2 ] and [ :And, 3 ]. A rotation count larger than the list wraps around, and a negative one kills the Ring process today. Shuffle gives a different order on every call.
